body.name: Hölder-margin Gaussian law class
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_{\beta,\alpha}^{\mathrm{HM}}=\{P: X_t\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}P_X,\ c_X\le p_X\le C_X,\ Y_t=\mu_{A_t}(X_t)+\sigma\varepsilon_t,\ \varepsilon_t\mid(H_{t-1},X_t,A_t)\sim\mathcal N(0,1)\text{ are conditionally independent innovations},\ \|\mu_a\|_\infty\le M,\ |\mu_a(x)-\mu_a(x')|\le L\|x-x'\|_2^\beta\ \text{for each }a,\ P_X(0<|\tau_P(X)|\le u)\le C_0u^\alpha\ \text{for }0\le u\le\delta_0,\ \alpha\beta\le d\}\).
